prompts.desktop: Precision text removal. Edit ONLY this landscape sky crop, 1050x450. Erase the large white overlay letters 'RELY R8', 'INTELLIGENTIZE', 'THE WORLD'. Fill the letter holes with the immediately surrounding ORIGINAL blue sky gradient and wispy diagonal cloud pattern. Do NOT introduce any new clouds or extra texture. Preserve the existing clouds, color gradient, framing, and all edge pixels as closely as possible, especially the outer 50-pixel border, because this image will be stitched back into the unaltered photo. Keep the exact aspect ratio and the existing sky appearance. No lettering, logos, objects, embellishments or new details. The result should look exactly like the input crop with only the white advertising letters removed.
